_comment: What constructs is called in Ruby.
constructs is nobody's product — it is the shared base library that both
aws-cdk-lib and cdk8s depend on. That is exactly why it gets its own
repository: two distribution repositories generating it under different
names would produce two incompatible gems sharing one name, and two
publishing the same version would overwrite each other's bytes and change
This entry must stay identical to the constructs entry in aws-cdk-ruby and
cdk8s-ruby, which still generate it as part of their own closures.
